what-exclusion-does.title: What an exclusion changes
what-exclusion-does.description: An excluded file loses inline suggestions, stops informing suggestions and responses, and is skipped by Copilot code review, while human access is unchanged.

exclusion-scope-levels.title: Who each rule level reaches
exclusion-scope-levels.description: Repository, organization and enterprise exclusions are configured by different owners and reach different sets of Copilot users.

repository-path-rules.title: Choosing a path pattern
repository-path-rules.description: Decide between an anchored path, a file name anywhere, a name wildcard or a directory tree when writing a repository exclusion.

organization-repository-references.title: How an organization rule matches
organization-repository-references.description: An organization rule applies to seat holders, matches a repository reference or the star key, then matches a path on a supported surface.

surface-support-matrix.title: Exclusion support by surface
surface-support-matrix.description: Inline and chat or agent support for content exclusion across IDEs, the Copilot app and CLI, cloud surfaces and code review.

exclusion-limitations.title: Layers around exclusion
exclusion-limitations.description: Repository access, operating-system permissions and content exclusion stack together, with documented exclusion gaps noted beside each layer.

propagation-and-testing.title: From save to verified rule
propagation-and-testing.description: Save a rule, wait up to 30 minutes or reload the IDE, then test a control file, the excluded file and chat before recording the result.

change-review-and-api.title: Exclusion change lifecycle
change-review-and-api.description: Propose and review a rule, save it in the UI or preview API, find the audit log entry, compare excluded_paths and record the result.

public-code-policy.title: Resolving the public code policy
public-code-policy.description: Trace whether an enterprise selection or organization settings determine Allow or Block, then check surface support before relying on Block.

code-referencing-review.title: Acting on a code reference
code-referencing-review.description: An accepted, unchanged suggestion that matches public code produces a log entry that a developer reviews to use, attribute or remove the code.

repository-access-layer.title: Access sits beneath exclusion
repository-access-layer.description: Base permissions, repository roles and deploy key reviews limit who can reach content before content exclusion limits what Copilot uses.

secret-push-protection.title: A blocked push and its bypass
secret-push-protection.description: A developer push containing a secret is blocked, then either fixed or bypassed with a reason that creates an alert and an audit log entry.
